strikes.name: bolt_thrust
strikes.look: PROVISIONAL. A palm thrust: the heel of the palm set on his chest, the shot let go as a short cone at the contact.
strikes.orig: PROVISIONAL: a palm thrust, the heel of the palm set on the chest, the other hand open in guard

strikes.name: bolt_flat
strikes.look: PROVISIONAL. A flat palm set on his gut, the forearm level, the shot let go at the contact.
strikes.orig: PROVISIONAL: a flat palm set on the gut, the forearm level, the body a little lower behind it

strikes.name: bolt_flick
strikes.look: PROVISIONAL. A palm flick: the hand carried in across him and let out in a short outward arc onto the chest, the shot going off at the contact.
strikes.orig: PROVISIONAL: a palm flick: the hand carried in across the body and let out in a short outward arc to the chest

strikes.name: bolt_sweep
strikes.look: PROVISIONAL. A flat palm swept inward across the gut from the outside, the shot going off at the contact.
strikes.orig: PROVISIONAL: a flat palm swept inward across the gut from the outside

strikes.name: blast_chest
strikes.look: PROVISIONAL. The blast: the palm set on his chest after a 12-tick gather held at the shoulder, the shot let go as a cone that carries him.
strikes.orig: PROVISIONAL: the blast: a 12-tick gather with the palm held at the shoulder and the other hand open in guard, then the palm set on the chest

strikes.name: blast_gut
strikes.look: PROVISIONAL. The blast on the gut: the palm set low after a 12-tick gather held at the shoulder, the shot a cone that carries him.
strikes.orig: PROVISIONAL: the blast on the gut: the same gather, the palm set low as the body drops behind it
